limitations.note: The rewrite fixed the red-to-green and green-to-yellow transitions but also asserted red during reset and removed the original startup pipeline, shifting the visible light and countdown timing that the reference fix preserves.
The test required red to be lit during reset, so its passing result confirmed the rewrite's timing assumptions rather than checking that the original reset and startup behavior was preserved.

limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire invocation before simulation, so the agent had to rerun the test using a different temporary-directory mechanism.
